content.text:
Inbound from CEO (channel=eng_direct): "We are getting p99 latency spikes on the /api/companies endpoint after the v48 migration. Figure out what broke and fix it by end of week."

Your ICs:
- agent_ic_be1 (senior backend IC, SQL + Node)
- agent_ic_be2 (mid backend IC, API + schema)
- agent_ic_fe (frontend, React)
- agent_ic_sre (SRE, metrics + profiling)

Trigger: message. Decompose the CEO directive into 2-4 IC-sized tasks now. Use /api/task/create for each. Do not write a plan document.

I'll decompose this latency investigation into tasks for the appropriate ICs.

<bash>
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:${AGENTCOMPANY_API_PORT}/api/task/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Instrument /api/companies endpoint with p99 latency metrics and identify spike pattern",
    "description": "Set up detailed monitoring for /api/companies to capture p99 latency spikes. Identify:\n- When spikes occur (time of day, load pattern)\n- Baseline vs spike latency values\n- Any correlation with request parameters\n- CPU/memory/DB connection pool metrics during spikes\n\nDeliver a summary doc with graphs showing the spike pattern and potential bottleneck areas (DB query, serialization, etc).",
    "assigneeAgentId": "agent_ic_sre",
    "dueAt": "2024-01-10T17:00:00Z"
  }'
</bash>

<bash>
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:${AGENTCOMPANY_API_PORT}/api/task/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Profile /api/companies SQL queries and compare v47 vs v48 execution plans",
    "description": "Investigate database-level changes from v48 migration affecting /api/companies:\n- Review migration scripts for schema changes to companies table or related tables\n- Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on all queries in the endpoint handler\n- Compare query plans with v47 (check for missing indexes, inefficient joins)\n- Check for N+1 query patterns introduced in v48\n- Identify the slowest query contributing to p99 spikes\n\nDeliver findings with specific query performance metrics and recommendations.",
    "assigneeAgentId": "agent_ic_be1",
    "dueAt": "2024-01-10T17:00:00Z"
  }'
</bash>

<bash>
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:${AGENTCOMPANY_API_PORT}/api/task/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Review /api/companies API handler code changes in v48 for performance regressions",
    "description": "Code-level investigation of /api/companies endpoint changes in v48:\n- Git diff the endpoint handler between v47 and v48\n- Look for synchronous operations that should be async\n- Check for added loops, redundant serialization, or blocking calls\n- Review any new middleware or validation logic in the request path\n- Check response payload size changes\n\nDeliver a code review doc highlighting any performance anti-patterns introduced in v48.",
    "assigneeAgentId": "agent_ic_be2",
    "dueAt": "2024-01-10T17:00:00Z"
  }'
</bash>

<bash>
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:${AGENTCOMPANY_API_PORT}/api/task/create \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Implement fixes for /api/companies p99 latency and deploy to staging",
    "description": "Based on findings from SRE profiling and BE1/BE2 investigations, implement the fix:\n- Apply recommended index additions or query optimizations\n- Refactor any synchronous code to async if identified\n- Add caching if appropriate\n- Run load tests in staging to verify p99 drops to acceptable levels (<200ms target)\n- Prepare production deploy plan with rollback strategy\n\nDeliver: fixed code in PR, staging test results, deploy runbook.",
    "assigneeAgentId": "agent_ic_be1",
    "dueAt": "2024-01-12T17:00:00Z"
  }'
</bash>

Tasks created. I've assigned the investigation phase to SRE (metrics), BE1 (SQL), and BE2 (API code), all due Wed EOD. BE1 will then implement the fix by Fri EOD based on the combined findings.
